review_candidates.company: SEE Talent Group Latino América- Headhunting
review_candidates.description: Objetivo de la posición Buscamos un profesional con perfil híbrido, capaz de combinar conocimientos de finanzas corporativas y estructuración financiera con una sólida capacidad de coordinación y ejecución operativa . La posición participará en el análisis y estructuración financiera de proyectos y emisiones, y será responsable de coordinar el proceso operativo de cada emisión de principio a fin, articulando equipos internos, proveedores externos y actores relacionados con cumplimiento. Principales responsabilidades Desarrollar y apoyar procesos de modelación financiera, valoración y evaluación de proyectos e inversiones . Participar en la estructuración de titularizaciones, deuda, leasing, LBOs y activos digitales . Realizar análisis de riesgos, escenarios financieros y capacidad de pago . Preparar análisis y reportería financiera para apoyar la toma de decisiones de la alta gerencia . Coordinar el proceso operativo de las emisiones, asegurando el cumplimiento de cronogramas, documentación y entregables. Levantar, organizar y dar seguimiento al checklist documental requerido para cada emisión. Coordinar con las diferentes áreas involucradas en la preparación del Documento de Información Relevante (DIR). Preparar y dar seguimiento al paquete documental requerido para el proceso de Cumplimiento . Coordinar la documentación y seguimiento con proveedores, asesores y demás partes externas involucradas en las emisiones. Apoyar y dar seguimiento al onboarding de inversionistas y registro de usuarios en la plataforma. Gestionar múltiples procesos y stakeholders de manera simultánea, escalando únicamente aquellos temas que requieran decisión de Dirección. Perfil que buscamos Profesional de Finanzas, Economía, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería de Negocios o carreras afines . Experiencia de 4 años o más en áreas relacionadas con finanzas corporativas, estructuración financiera, inversiones, análisis financiero, banca, fintech, operaciones financieras o similares. Conocimientos o experiencia en modelación y análisis financiero . Deseable experiencia o exposición a estructuración de deuda, titularizaciones, inversiones, activos digitales u otros instrumentos financieros . Capacidad para comprender información financiera y, al mismo tiempo, gestionar procesos, documentación y múltiples stakeholders . Excel / Google Sheets. Deseable manejo de herramientas de gestión como Trello, Asana o Notion. Experiencia en ambientes regulados como banca, servicios financieros, fiduciarias, fintech, legal o consultoría será valorada. Inglés intermedio avanzado (mayormente lectura y escritura) Competencias clave Buscamos una persona con pensamiento analítico, organización rigurosa, atención al detalle, capacidad de seguimiento, comunicación efectiva y autonomía , capaz de desenvolverse con tiempos límites y coordinar simultáneamente diferentes actores y fechas de entrega. Condiciones de la posición Modalidad: Remota Horario: Lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 5:00 p. m. Central Time. Enfoque de trabajo: Posición orientada a resultados, cumplimiento de objetivos, entregables y asignaciones. Salario: A convenir, de acuerdo con experiencia y conocimientos técnicos. Contratación: Posición permanente / contratación directa.

review_candidates.description: About Us BPS, established in Indonesia in 2018, is a company that provides alternative credit scoring services, which is a reliable indicator to assess an individual's level of creditworthiness in meeting their financial obligations. BPS utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) technology to analyze various alternative data used in alternative credit scoring products. Alternative data sources include information managed by e-commerce companies, social media, payment gateways, and telecommunications. Why Join BPS Innovation: Be part of a company that thrives on innovation and embraces the opportunities presented by AI and alternative data. Impact: Contribute to reshaping the future of financial services by promoting inclusivity and offering a fair assessment of individuals' financial capabilities. Collaborative Culture: Join a dynamic, collaborative team where your ideas are valued, and your growth is nurtured. If you're ready to be part of a team that is redefining the rules of the game in the financial industry, we invite you to explore opportunities at PT Bangun Percaya Sosial. Join us on this exciting journey as we pave the way for a more inclusive and informed financial ecosystem. Job Overview We are looking for an Account Manager to manage and grow strategic client relationships for our alternative credit scoring solutions. You will be the key point of contact for enterprise clients, ensuring strong customer engagement, successful product adoption, retention, and long-term account growth. This role is ideal for someone with strong B2B relationship management experience who understands the fintech, financial services, data, or technology space and can translate client needs into practical solutions while identifying opportunities to expand existing partnerships. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise clients, building strong relationships and ensuring high customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships. Drive renewals, retention, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities across existing accounts. Understand clients' business needs, challenges, and objectives, and recommend solutions that maximize the value of alternative credit scoring products. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to present business performance, product adoption, key insights, and growth opportunities. Monitor account health, identify potential risks or issues, and proactively drive resolutions with clients and internal teams. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Support teams to ensure successful service delivery and a positive client experience. Develop account plans, track account performance, forecast renewals, and maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records. Gather client feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to support product improvements and business growth. Identify opportunities to deepen strategic partnerships and contribute to overall revenue growth from the client portfolio. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Management, Information Systems, or a related field. 5–7 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Relationship Management, or B2B Sales, preferably within fintech, banking, SaaS, credit bureau, data solutions, or enterprise technology. Professional proficiency in English, Bahasa Indonesia, and Mandarin, both spoken and written. Proven track record of managing enterprise accounts, driving renewals and retention, and growing existing client relationships. Strong understanding of the financial services industry, lending ecosystem, or credit risk is preferred. Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven and commercial mindset. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple client accounts and priorities. Familiarity with API-based, data-driven, or technology-enabled solutions is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Account Executive, Deel IT - LATAM
review_candidates.description: Who we are is what we do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers. Why should you be part of our success story? As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google. Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. Summary: Deel IT exists to equip the world's talent with the means to do their best work. Through one slick platform customers can procure, deploy, repair & recover entire fleets of devices and home office equipment for their employees in over 120 countries. Your Responsibilities: Hungry for success: You’re passionate and driven, and you’re willing to take risks, be creative, and always resilient. Seasoned sales professional: You have experience selling to MM (From 200 to 2,000 employees) sized customers, ideally a software-led product, and having strong success as a net new logo hunter. Ownership and execution: You take ownership of the complete sales cycle from start to finish, navigating complex commercial deals by building strong relationships and negotiating to a close. Strong Communicator: You are an excellent communicator with great presentation skills. You can effectively articulate and leverage the Deel IT value proposition to win the trust of customers and close deals. Owner mindset: You're passionate about Deel IT's product and mission and positively display this at every interaction within the sales cycle and beyond. Key Requirements: 2+ years of sales quota carrying experience - ideally in IT SaaS ( MDM, IAM, device lifecycle, SaaS procurement, or adjacent categories ). Seen great success: You have been an integral part of at least one great business success story, and know what it takes to deliver outlier results. Closing: A strong background in getting B2B software-led product sales across the line. You are an expert individual contributor with an excellent track record. Builder: You're willing and able to build out strong pipelines, whilst fluidly partnering with a BDR. Accurate and accountable: You can accurately forecast your sales results, you see the gaps in your pipeline and you are ahead of the curve, you strive to always go above and beyond. Teamwork: You have experience collaborating with teams across a growing company and building strong relationships. Thrive in a global remote team environment Total Rewards Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission. Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion. Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location. We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it. Some things you'll enjoy Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page . Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email ( recruiting@deel.com ) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations. This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy . For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT

review_candidates.description: Account Executive – Manufacturing – Hybrid We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers. If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more. About The Job The EMEA Manufacturing sales team is hiring an Account Executive to assist customers and prospects in the DACH region in shaping their data and AI strategies and modernizing their solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, Worker Safety, …). The role involves understanding business challenges, presenting SAS solutions, and building relationships with key accounts in the Manufacturing market. The focus will be on driving growth by leveraging existing relationships and creating new ones. This position offers a chance for an experienced sales professional to drive strategic enterprise Manufacturing accounts. You’ll grow alongside a supportive team, learn from industry leaders, and make a lasting impact by turning complex challenges into meaningful solutions. The role can be based in Germany (Frankfurt, Munich), in Switzerland (Zurich), in Austria (Vienna) or in France (Paris) with hybrid working model and will require traveling as per business needs. As an Account Executive – Manufacturing, you will Be responsible for achievement of total software revenue target and management business objectives. Engage with targeted customers and prospect accounts to position SAS solutions, managing deals typically between $100K to $1M+. Deliver strategies to modernize customer engagement for strategic clients. Build and maintain relationships, influencing long-term strategies and engaging with C-level decision-makers. Provide knowledge in industry, business, and marketing technology to close deals in your assigned territory. Support lead-generation activities and integrate strategies into account plans, qualifying based on business and technical fit. Develop opportunities and create compelling proposals to communicate the value of SAS solutions, collaborating with internal teams Support the closure of complex sales and assist with pricing and licensing negotiations. Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do. Required Qualifications 4-5 years of experience in selling solutions and services to both business owners and IT stakeholders. Experience in addressing the Manufacturing industry. Demonstrated experience in account mapping and in navigating in complex ecosystem. Ability to analyze and evaluate territory dynamics and develop a sales plan; ability to communicate technical and business concepts and relate them to SAS applications and user needs; ability to work independently and as part of a team. Knowledge of SaaS complex solution sales ideally with a focus on data analytics, AI, Generative AI. Awareness of SAS solutions and services preferred. Fluent in German and in English. Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications. Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills Sales Planning: Develops and executes strategic sales plans to achieve revenue targets and drive business growth. Customer Centricity: Prioritizes customer needs and delivers tailored solutions that enhance satisfaction and loyalty. Relationship Building: Cultivates strong, trust-based relationships with clients and stakeholders to foster long-term partnerships. Obstacle Navigation: Proactively identifies and overcomes challenges to maintain momentum and deliver results. Insight Driven Value Creation: Leverages data and market insights to craft compelling value propositions that address client pain points. Self-Motivation: Demonstrates initiative and drive to exceed goals independently in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. Benefits Highlights You will receive a competitive salary package and fringe benefits. You will grow in an energizing environment – our facilities in those countries are amazing. You will enjoy flexibility as we operate in a hybrid model. You are welcome here At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers. Additional Information SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact Recruitingsupport@sas.com. Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.

You’re empowered to succeed, encouraged to grow, and the work you do helps run what runs the world. This position reports to Global Marketing & Communications Head - BL Digital Join ABB's Digital Business Line as a Global Content Marketing Specialist and help accelerate growth of ABB's AI-enabled industrial software portfolio. This role is ideal for a creative marketer who combines strong story-telling skills with modern AI-powered content creation capabilities. You will develop compelling content, vid-eos, campaigns, and sales tools that showcase how ABB's digital solutions help customers improve perfor-mance, increase reliability, optimize energy use, and advance toward autonomous operations. This position is within ABB’s Energy Industries division that serves many of the world's most critical industries, from oil and gas and power generation to water, chemicals, and life sciences. Key Responsibilities Content Creation & Digital Storytelling Create high-impact marketing content across multiple formats, including videos, customer stories, social media, infographics, webpages, sales presentations, thought leadership articles, white papers, eBooks, and campaign assets. Transform complex technical concepts into clear, engaging, customer-focused narratives that reso-nate with operators, engineers, business leaders, and executives. Use generative AI tools to accelerate content development, improve productivity, and personalize content for different audiences. Produce and edit video content for product launches, customer success stories, executive thought leadership, social media campaigns, events, and sales enablement initiatives. Maintain ABB brand standards while continuously introducing fresh, creative approaches to content development. Work model: Hybrid Product Marketing Launch Support Create sales enablement and marketing assets to support product launches, including sales presenta-tions, short product videos, webinars, customer testimonials, social media ads and product webpage content. Collaborate closely with product management and subject matter experts to translate technical capa-bilities into outcome-based customer benefits. Marketing and Sales Enablement Create and maintain global sales tools, messaging, and resources that support consistent positioning and growth of ABB's digital solutions for Energy Industries. Develop marketing content and campaign assets tailored by target customers and personas aligned with strategic growth initiatives. Develop content for a wide range of uses from social media, trade media, events and customer com-munications to position ABB as an industrial software leader. Partner with regional and local marketing teams to adapt content for different markets and audi-ences. Monitor content performance and apply AI and data-driven insights to optimize messaging based on engagement metrics. Your background and skills 5+ years of marketing or content creation, preferably within industrial companies Ability to use generative AI to enhance productivity and creativity Able to express technically complex content in easy-to-understand form Storytelling and content strategy development, with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, combined with creativity, innovation, and a passion for delivering fresh ideas aligned with brand po-sitioning. Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), video production and editing (Adobe Premiere and Canva), Microsoft Office, CoPilot and Claude, social media Knowledge of digital marketing and marketing automation tools (Salesforce and Pardot) Collaborative mindset, strong networking skills, and a team-oriented approach. Ability to manage several large projects at any given time Fluent in English More About Us ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and re-source-efficient future. By connecting its engineering and digitalization expertise, ABB helps industries run at high performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform. Role Description The Incident Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of incidents, including detection, triage, escalation, coordination of technical resources, and resolution. The Incident Manager will monitor systems and service queues, lead incident response calls, communicate status updates to stakeholders, and ensure accurate documentation in incident tracking tools. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Prior experience in an Incident Manager, Service Desk Lead, or similar operational role within an IT or technology-driven organization is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Founding Sales Partner
review_candidates.description: 📍 Remote | Commission-based pay Automera helps businesses turn repetitive work and disconnected systems into efficient, connected operations. Our work includes AI assistants for customer enquiries and booking coordination, automated follow-ups, CRM integrations, documents processing and workflows that connect the tools a business already uses. We combine AI, APIs, and custom development to build practical solutions around real operational needs. We’re looking for a sales partner who can understand those needs, communicate the value of our solutions, and own the process of winning new business. What you’ll do Identify businesses with relevant operational challenges and reach the right decision-makers. Build a qualified pipeline through research, outreach, and professional relationships. Lead discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s processes, priorities, and budget. Present relevant solutions and demonstrations with support from the technical team. Prepare proposals, handle objections, and negotiate within agreed pricing and delivery scope. Follow opportunities through to signed agreements and paid contracts. Maintain accurate sales activity in HubSpot and coordinate a clear handover to delivery. Use feedback from prospects to help sharpen our offers and commercial strategy. Who we’re looking for Someone who enjoys opening doors, asking thoughtful questions, and turning a promising conversation into a commercial agreement. You should have experience personally sourcing and closing B2B deals, communicate confidently with owners and decision-makers, and work independently with clear accountability. One or more years of experience selling software, automation, digital services, or professional services is a must. An existing business network is an advantage. You do need curiosity about technology and the ability to explain how a solution can improve a business’s day-to-day work. Why this opportunity matters This is an early opportunity to help build Automera’s commercial growth, with a direct voice in the markets we pursue, the offers we develop and the sales approach we establish. The right person will have room to take ownership, make a visible contribution, and grow their responsibilities as the business expands. Strong results and sustained contribution will be rewarded generously, with substantial earning potential tied to the business you bring in. Technical expertise, relevant demonstrations, and support with solution design will be provided, allowing you to focus on developing opportunities and closing them confidently. Compensation is commission-based, with no base salary. Clear terms and expectations will be agreed before starting.
